diagnosis: The remote session revocation handler terminates Redis-backed HTTP sessions by ID directly from the path variable without checking whether the session belongs to the caller's account. An attacker can enumerate session keys to selectively kill active authentication sessions of incident response personnel and security engineers during operational activities.
